description: Replace the PyTorch QR path with a shape-specialized CUDA C++ tiled Householder/TSQR kernel family for QR_v2, fusing column norm, reflector/dot reductions, trailing update, and Q/R materialization to eliminate torch.linalg and Python-level launch overhead while improving SM occupancy.

Implement an independent CUDA C++ modified Gram-Schmidt QR path for QR_v2 small/medium shapes, using one CTA or CTA-group per matrix, shared-memory column storage, warp/block reductions for dot/norm, and batched grids that expose enough matrices/tiles to saturate the GPU.

Add guarded CUDA C++ fast paths for structured QR_v2 inputs such as already-upper-triangular, rank-deficient, clustered, or near-rank cases, detecting structure cheaply and constructing valid Q/R outputs without full factorization when mathematically safe.

Combine d681aac small-shape CUDA Householder with a696139 structured-input fast paths: preserve the validated n<=176 custom QR route and torch.geqrf fallback elsewhere, add only the safe n=4096 upper/rank-deficient detectors, resolve integration conflicts, and avoid any broad or speculative n=512 routing.

Implement a native CUDA C++ large-n batched QR fast path for n=512/1024 using blocked Householder panels with compact WY representation: fixed small panel width in shared memory, panel/tau only in shared memory, global-memory trailing updates across batched grids, targeting torch-fallback overhead and insufficient large-n parallelism while explicitly avoiding full-matrix dynamic shared memory.

Target the n=352 mid-size gap with a separate CUDA C++ fast path using blocked Householder panels of small fixed width, shared memory for panel/tau/reduction scratch, and batched global-memory trailing updates, while preserving the existing n<=176 compact route and larger-n torch.geqrf fallback.

Eliminate the torch fallback bottleneck for batch=60,n=1024 with an in-dispatch CUDA C++ blocked Householder panel path: preserve existing n<=176 and structured n=4096 fast paths, reuse existing Householder primitives when natural, keep shared memory panel-width-limited, perform trailing updates through global memory, and avoid any new standalone detector launches.

Combine ae5cd11, 7092b24, and 412b633 into one dispatch: preserve the n<=176 and n=352 custom CUDA QR routes, retain safe n=4096 upper/rank-deficient structured fast paths, integrate the guarded n=512 rank-deficient/tail-zero path, keep dense/mixed/unsupported shapes on fallback, and resolve dispatch priority without adding per-call GPU detector launches or extra classification overhead.

Replace the failed serial one-CTA n=1024 QR path with a genuine multi-CTA blocked Householder design: CTAs cooperate on panel statistics/reductions and independently own row-band or column-tile trailing updates in global memory, avoiding single-CTA per-column update loops and avoiding extra detector launches.

Reduce host dispatch overhead in the combined n<=352 / n4096 / guarded n512 QR path by caching extension handles, collapsing redundant Python/Torch shape and dtype checks, and replacing general route predicates with cheap host-side size-specialized guards while preserving the no-extra-GPU-detector design.

Redesign the n=352 CUDA QR path from 97199151 to eliminate per-column trailing-update launch storms by fusing multiple column updates per panel or using a persistent grid-stride update kernel while preserving the current combined dispatch behavior.

Extend the current combined best with CUDA C++ fast paths for n=512 clustered/near-rank structured cases beyond the existing tail-zero rank-deficient route, using mathematically safe host-side shape/structure guards already available in dispatch, constructing valid Q/R without broad dense routing, and avoiding new standalone GPU detector launches.

Exploit the ranked n=1024 near-rank case by extending the validated truncated-QR strategy: detect repeated-tail columns with strict relative guards, factor only the leading 3n/4 columns in CUDA C++, construct tail R columns from corresponding leading columns, set tail tau zero, and preserve fallback for dense or failed-guard batches.

Tune the n=512 relaxed-tail dispatch from 14e6dff: profile guard/route overhead, try tighter thresholds around <=1e-5 such as 3e-6 and 3e-5, preserve the exact host-side residual guard, avoid new reductions, and route only clustered/rank-like n=512 cases with clear validation margin.

Combine 14e6dff and ba97c8bd: preserve the current n<=176, n512 relaxed-tail, and n4096 dispatch behavior from the global best while cleanly integrating ba97c8bd's n=352 warp-per-column persistent grouped trailing-column update to reduce launch overhead; avoid unrelated host-dispatch micro-tuning and do not alter n1024 routes.

Combine global best e061edeb with c33dc33: preserve e061 dispatch plus n=512 and n=4096 behavior, but replace its ba97 n=352 grouped update with c33's 384-thread, 12-trailing-column warp-per-column update. Target the n=352 memory/parallelism bottleneck only; avoid n=1024 and host dispatch tuning.

Independently retune e061's n512 relaxed-tail threshold/guard around the current <=1e-5 setting, especially <=3e-6, while preserving e061's combined dispatch and n352 grouped update; avoid n1024 changes, host dispatch edits, new reductions, or broadening active size coverage.

Profile e061 small-n QR at n=32 and n=176, then locally tune the existing n<=176 CUDA QR path with n176-specific launch/block/unroll/fast-math variants and shape splits while leaving n352/n512/n1024/n4096 dispatch behavior untouched.

Profile only the n352 grouped-update path in the current c33/e061 winner and retune its 384-thread, 12-column warp update locally: compare 10/12/14 update columns, register pressure, shared-memory staging, and occupancy; preserve existing n512/n4096/small-n dispatch and avoid host dispatch or n1024 changes.

Starting from aa82f211, graft only 037cf2fc's n512 relaxed tail-guard threshold <=3e-6 onto the existing e061 dispatch/c33 n352 path; preserve aa82's n352 384-thread/12-col update and n4096/small-n dispatch, and reject any donor n1024 or host-dispatch changes.

Profile and locally tune only the existing n4096 structured upper/rank-deficient fast path, reducing output construction, tau allocation, and flag-reduction overhead without adding detector launches or changing other dispatch paths.

Add a strictly gated CholeskyQR fast path for well-conditioned dense n512/n1024/n2048 cases by computing tiled A^T A, Cholesky R, and Q=A*R^{-1}, falling back to existing QR on Cholesky failure, weak diagonals, or unsupported shapes.

Combine aa82f211 and d479d3c: start from aa82f211 global best and graft only d479d3c's n32-specific 64-thread launch split to reduce small-n launch/occupancy overhead; preserve aa82f211 behavior for n352/n512/n4096 and avoid changing n176/n1024 dispatch or host-side routing.

Profile aa82f211 custom-route output materialization overhead across existing n<=176, n352, n512 rankdef, and n4096 structured paths, then reduce only shared H/tau allocation, copy, zero-init, and compact Householder handoff costs using empty/empty_like choices and fused fill/copy kernels where safe; preserve every route predicate and algorithm.

Tune the aa82 small/medium-n dense path for n176 by reducing arithmetic and register pressure without changing the n32 split logic, n352 grouped update, output materialization strategy, or larger-shape dispatch.

Add a guarded n2048/n4096 small-batch multi-CTA blocked MGS/TSQR path that parallelizes one matrix across CTAs, uses compact panel/reduction temporaries, preserves existing QR output format, and falls back to aa82 for all other shapes or failed correctness cases.

Build a CUDA C++ specialized batched n=512 QR path that replaces the current panel/update route with a warp-tiled blocked Householder pipeline using shared-memory column tiles and fused norm/dot/update kernels, preserving existing dispatch predicates and leaving n176/n352/n4096 untouched.

Build a CUDA C++ specialized n=1024 dense-batch QR route that bypasses detector launches and torch fallback entirely: dispatch directly for n1024, compute compact Householder panels with cooperative CTA groups, and apply trailing updates using separate row/column tile CTAs over global-memory tiles; touch only n1024 dispatch and avoid changing n512/n2048 paths.

Combine c88472a's n32 64-thread split and 53c3e9af's n176 192-thread launch onto aa82f211, preserving aa82 n352 12-column update, n512/n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization; benchmark each graft independently and together, keeping only launch-specialization changes that improve geomean without regressing dominant large-n shapes.

From f02082659f0f167e927444f1065d213109b2a0c7, micro-tune only the existing n4096 structured upper/rank-deficient route: profile its detector/output overhead, then reduce it by fusing flag scan, H/tau fill, and output materialization or tightening host predicates. Preserve f020's n512 kernels, aa82's n352 path, and all small-n dispatch.

Graft only 44fc5c0's validated n32 64-thread and n176 192-thread launch splits onto the current n512 winner 6d38a275. Preserve 6d38's n512 20-column/640-thread kernels, aa82 n352 route, n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization exactly; validate no cross-size regression before keeping.

Micro-tune only de434's inherited n352 grouped-update path: first profile the aa82/c33 12-column 384-thread warp-per-column update under the current dispatch mix for occupancy, register pressure, memory efficiency, and warp stalls, then test nearby grouped-update column widths/thread counts or register-pressure reductions while preserving de434 n512 kernels, n32/n176 launch splits, n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization.

Micro-tune only de434's n512 rankdef CUDA C++ grouped-update path around the 20-column/640-thread winner: profile occupancy/register pressure/memory efficiency, then test nearby width x block-size variants such as 21/22 columns with 608/672/704 threads, preserving n32/n176 splits, aa82 n352, n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization.

Add a CUDA C++ n2048 strict-structure fast path from de434 for host-detectable all-zero tail or exact repeated trailing columns only: cheaply predicate before routing, factor only active leading columns with compact per-column kernels modeled on the n512 route, synthesize tail R/tau, and fall back byte-for-byte to existing dense n2048 behavior for all other inputs.

Continue micro-tuning only 801146's n352 grouped-update path around the 16-column/512-thread winner: benchmark adjacent width/block/register variants not already covered, especially 14/448, 15/480, 18/576, plus occupancy/register-pressure reductions that preserve the same algorithm. Do not alter n512 kernels, n32/n176 launch splits, n1024/n2048/n4096 dispatch, or materialization.

Graft only 9983173's n512 grouped-update retune onto 801146: change n512 from 20-column/640-thread to 22-column/704-thread only if the patch touches n512 grouped-update constants or launch parameters. Preserve 801146's n352 16-column/512-thread path, n32/n176 launch splits, n1024/n2048/n4096 dispatch, and materialization; reject any donor changes outside n512.

Graft only 456077e's strict n2048 rank-1536 all-zero trailing-column CUDA C++ fast path onto 801146, preserving 801146's n352 16-column/512-thread path, n512 20-column/640-thread kernels, n32/n176 launch splits, n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization; reject donor predicate micro-tunes, repeated-tail changes, and any non-n2048 behavior drift.

Micro-tune only current-best CUDA/C++ host dispatch and output materialization overhead for the existing n32/n176/n352/n512 custom paths: profile extension route selection plus H/tau allocation/fill, then remove redundant C++ checks, zero/empty fills, or wrapper launches while preserving identical route predicates, QR algorithms, kernel constants, and n1024/n2048/n4096 behavior.

Micro-tune only d9ad5139843b411e3bd553f1a061f4ac27960535's n2048 all-zero trailing-column rank-1536 fast-path kernel internals: profile compact factor/update kernels first, then test grouped trailing-update widths, block shapes, unroll/register-pressure variants, and shared-memory staging analogous to n352/n512 winners, preserving the exact zero-tail predicate, fallback behavior, n352/n512/small-n paths, n1024/n4096 dispatch, and materialization.

Graft only 136960ff's n352 reduction/update tweak onto d9ad513: compute tau*warp_sum directly and group the update shuffle after lane0 writes to cut redundant work/synchronization, while preserving d9ad's n2048 zero-tail path, n512 kernels, n32/n176 splits, n1024/n4096 dispatch, materialization, and route predicates; reject any unlogged branch-removal unless independently rederived and validated.
